name: energy-ball
description: Glowing energy orb with sparks that sits on the speaker's hand (Rasengan-style).

name: stat-card
description: One big number that counts up on a white card with a highlighter sweep, a label and an optional note; optional darkened screenshot behind.

params.value: the number (counts up from 0; decimals kept)
params.prefix: optional text before the number, e.g. "$"
params.suffix: optional text after the number, e.g. "%" or " mln"
params.label: what the number means (short sentence)
params.media: optional screenshot shown darkened behind the card

name: flow
description: Step-by-step diagram: 2-6 numbered boxes pop in one by one and arrows draw between them (clean cards or hand-drawn Rough.js).

name: ui-mock
description: Mock app window whose text types in character by character: an AI chat, a terminal session or a social post.

params.lines: [{"who": "user"|"ai"|"cmd", "text": "..."}, ...] (terminal: user/cmd typed after $, ai printed as output)
params.title: optional window / account name

name: iso-machine
description: Isometric 3D machine (product-diagram style): 2-5 parts drop in and assemble on a conveyor, gears turn, a press stamps, tokens index through station by station, numbered labels point at the parts, optional output counter.

params.parts: 2-5 items {"label", "shape": "box"|"cylinder"|"funnel"|"screen"|"gear", "color"?} in process order (box = housing, cylinder = piston press, funnel = hopper, screen = monitor + scanner, gear = gearbox)
params.token: optional "cube" or "sphere": items travelling through the parts on the conveyor
params.counter: optional {"to": number, "label": "..."}: an output crate whose number counts up as tokens land in it
params.title: optional heading above the machine
params.accent: optional accent colour for tokens / crate / screen (default theme --accent)
